# Percentage Calculator

> > Free online percentage calculator for quick mathematical computations including percentage formulas and financial calculations.

Percentage Calculator is a web-based math tool developed by JX Software Ltd (Helsinki, Finland) that provides instant percentage calculations with support for various input formats and decimal separators. The service runs on AWS infrastructure (S3, CloudFront, Route 53) and uses Google Analytics for analytics.

- Percentage calculations
- Math formulas
- Online calculator
- Financial calculations
